locations.name: Sedge Landing
locations.playerDescription: A rickety dock on the north bank, where the rope ferry is moored.
locations.aiDescription: A rickety wooden dock on the north bank of the Ashen River. The water here runs milk-pale and dead silent - locals call this stretch the gloamwater. A single lantern hangs from a leaning post where notices are nailed; a rope ferry is moored at the dock, its far end lost in mist. locations.aiSummary: A north-bank dock over the silent gloamwater; a rope ferry moored in mist.

locations.name: Far Bank
locations.playerDescription: The south bank, with a half-sunk mill wheel and a watchman's shelter.
locations.aiDescription: The south bank, reached only by the rope ferry. A half-sunk mill wheel turns slow against the current, its iron fittings gone pale blue with rust. A watchman's shelter of tarred canvas stands above the waterline.
locations.aiSummary: The south bank: a half-sunk mill wheel and a watchman's canvas shelter.

locations.name: Sedge Hamlet
locations.playerDescription: The little north-bank village up the path from the landing.
locations.aiDescription: The huddle of turf-roofed houses on the north bank, a short climb up from the landing. A grouping for the green, the cottage, and the eelhouse - one is never standing 'in the hamlet' as such, only in one of its places.
locations.aiSummary: The north-bank village above the landing.

locations.name: The Common Green
locations.playerDescription: The hamlet's green, with a stone well at its center.
locations.aiDescription: A trodden common green ringed by turf-roofed houses. At its center stands a stone well with a blue-glazed rim; the well-rope is always coiled left-handed, widdershins, and folk re-coil it that way without thinking. Paths lead down to the landing, across to the ferryman's cottage, and to the eelhouse.
locations.aiSummary: The hamlet green with a blue-rimmed well whose rope is coiled widdershins.

locations.name: Ferryman's Cottage
locations.playerDescription: Bram's low turf-roofed cottage at the green's edge.
locations.aiDescription: The ferryman's own cottage: a low house with a turf roof and a door painted the same pale blue as rusted iron. A three-legged cat named Sixpence sleeps on the windowsill and answers to no one. The ferryman's sister keeps the place while he works the rope.
locations.aiSummary: The ferryman's turf-roofed cottage; a three-legged cat named Sixpence on the sill.

locations.name: The Eelhouse
locations.playerDescription: A smoke-blackened hut where river-eels are cured.
locations.aiDescription: A smoke-blackened hut hung with racks of curing river-eels. The door is chalked with a running tally of the catch that is wiped clean and restarted at every new moon. No one tends it just now.
locations.aiSummary: A smoke-blackened eel-curing hut; its door-tally resets each new moon.

entities.name: Bram
entities.aiDescription: Bram is the ferryman: a broad, weathered man with only one arm - the right; his left sleeve is pinned up - and a brass ring through his left ear. He speaks in short dry sentences and never crosses the river after dark. He has not told the player his name.
entities.aiSummary: The one-armed ferryman who won't cross after dark.

entities.name: Odette
entities.playerDescription: A woman smoking eels by the firepit.
entities.aiDescription: A small, quick woman smoking river-eels over a firepit at the landing, waiting to cross. She has a burn scar across her right cheek and a green glass bead braided into her hair. She distrusts strangers and counts everything twice. She has not given her name.
entities.aiSummary: The scarred eel-smoker waiting to cross; distrusts strangers.

entities.name: Rope Ferry
entities.playerDescription: A flat raft pulled along a rope.
entities.aiDescription: A flat wooden raft pulled along a single tar-black rope strung across the gloamwater. It carries two people at most and lists badly to the left; crossing means both hands on the rope.
entities.aiSummary: A two-person rope raft that lists to the left.

entities.name: Tomas
entities.aiDescription: Tomas is the far-bank watchman: a lean old man wrapped in a tarred canvas cloak, blind in one eye - a milky left eye - and leaning on a fishing spear. He challenges everyone who lands and gives his name to no one until they state their business.
entities.aiSummary: The one-eyed far-bank watchman with a fishing spear.

entities.name: Wick
entities.playerDescription: The ferryman's sister, who keeps the cottage.
entities.aiDescription: Wick is the ferryman's sister, who keeps the cottage while he works the rope. She is tall and stooped, with a silver eyetooth that shows when she hums - she hums almost constantly and speaks rarely, and never to a stranger. She has not given the player her name.
entities.aiSummary: The ferryman's sister who keeps the cottage; silver-toothed, always humming, wary of strangers.

entities.name: Mara
entities.aiSummary: A traveling healer sorting clean bandages beside a chest at the landing.
entities.aiDescription: Mara is a traveling healer with a copper clasp on her cloak and a pale birthmark on her left temple. She cleans minor cuts with boiled water and wraps them in clean linen. She speaks gently and carries no stitching needles. She has not given the player her name.
entities.playerDescription: A traveling healer sorting clean bandages beside a chest at the landing.

entities.name: Iven
entities.aiSummary: A cobbler repairing travelers' footwear on a low stool at the landing.
entities.aiDescription: Iven is a cobbler wearing a yellow wool cap and a dark leather apron. He repairs loose soles with waxed thread and a curved awl; he has no glue. He speaks slowly and asks to inspect the damaged boot before quoting a price. He has not given the player his name.
entities.playerDescription: A cobbler repairing travelers' footwear on a low stool at the landing.

entities.name: Nessa
entities.aiSummary: A basketmaker counting empty reed baskets near the path.
entities.aiDescription: Nessa is a basketmaker with a red cloth tied around her right wrist. She weaves split river reeds and marks finished baskets with three charcoal dots. She is waiting for a buyer and speaks in a brisk, cheerful voice. She has not given the player her name.
entities.playerDescription: A basketmaker counting empty reed baskets near the path.

entities.name: Corin
entities.aiSummary: A courier waiting at the landing with a sealed satchel.
entities.aiDescription: Corin is a courier with a white scarf and a square wooden badge. His satchel is sealed with violet wax. He keeps it on his lap and refuses to reveal its contents. He is waiting for a message runner from the village. He has not given the player his name.
entities.playerDescription: A courier waiting at the landing with a sealed satchel.

You scan the landing, your gaze passing over the cobbler on his low stool and the basketmaker counting her reeds. Beside a heavy wooden chest, a woman with a copper clasp on her cloak is sorting through piles of white linen.

function.description:
Purpose: Retrieve an entity's full authored entry. Entity summaries identify candidates for the story.
Use when: Before an entity appears in your upcoming narration, retrieve its full entry for this response. This includes named, indirect, and background appearances.
Input: name — the entity's name from the entity list.
Output: JSON with a matches array. Each match contains id, name, and the full authored description when provided by the author. An empty matches array means no matching entity was found.

You lift your foot, feeling the loose sole of your boot flap uselessly against your heel. Your eyes scan the landing until they find a man sitting on a low stool, hunched over a piece of leather. He wears a yellow wool cap and a dark leather apron stained with oils.

You limp toward him, each step a chore for your travel-worn feet. As you arrive at his side, he looks up from his work. You gesture down at the damaged boot. "The sole has come loose," you say softly. "Can it be fixed?"

He speaks slowly, his voice deep and measured. "I can stitch it back on with waxed thread." He reaches out a calloused hand, gesturing for you to set the boot on his stool beside him. "Let me see the damage first. Then I'll tell you what it will cost."
